subject: Post-demo: HealthBridge -> Redwood — SSO/SCIM, SOC 2 & vendor questionnaire
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: HealthBridge -> Redwood — SSO/SCIM, SOC 2 & vendor questionnaire

Hi Claire — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on security and integration items: 

Recap from our call:
- HealthBridge is evaluating Redwood for clinical note generation and summarization across three product teams (Care Ops, Revenue Ops, and Clinical Documentation).
- Primary security asks: SOC 2 report (Type II), HIPAA business associate controls, data residency options, and SSO/SCIM for provisioning.
- Integration note: HealthBridge wants SAML 2.0 single sign-on and SCIM v2 for user provisioning with RBAC mapped to your Teams/Org structure.

Proposed next steps:
1) We’ll send a concise evidence pack with SOC 2 summary + security overview (attached placeholder).
2) Technical sync: Hiro (our integration engineer) can run a 45-minute SAML/SCIM walkthrough and capture HealthBridge metadata/endpoints. Can you share an availability window for this week?
3) Please send the completed vendor questionnaire (or the POC contact who will own it). If easier, we can intake it in a shared Drive and mark items we’ll own vs items for your IT/Sec team.

Attachments included: redwood-sso-scim-overview.pdf (integration patterns), placeholder-SOC2-summary.pdf

If that sounds good I’ll schedule the technical sync for Hiro + Soojin + me. Thanks — we’ll aim to keep the security intake scoped so it doesn’t block the pilot timeline.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

----
Note: This message is being sent from the sales mailbox. For attestations or formal SOC 2 reports we will route to our Compliance team and provide a signed NDA if needed.

Claire / Evan — thanks for the quick reply and the questionnaire. Short answers now, more detail at the technical sync: 

1) BAA: Redwood offers a BAA for customers with covered PHI; we'll route through Legal and can provide a standard BAA template. I'll flag this for Execs if you want a draft prior to the security meeting.
2) Data residency: By default hosted workloads run in region selected at account creation; we support US-only deployment regions. I'll include the exact region list in the evidence pack.
3) SOC 2: We can provide a SOC 2 Type II summary now and the audited report under NDA. I’ve attached a short SOC 2 summary stub for your intake.

Technical intake proposal:
- Hiro will run the SAML metadata exchange and SCIM attribute mapping exercise. We typically send a SAML metadata XML and a SCIM sample payload + mapping doc before the call so engineers can validate endpoints.
- Deliverables we’ll provide before the call: redwood-sso-scim-overview.pdf (attached), sample SAML metadata URL, sample SCIM user CSV for mapping, and a checklist mapping RBAC roles -> SCIM groups.

Can we propose Wed 1/12 or Thu 1/13 at 10:00 AM EST for the technical sync? If those don’t work, share 2 slots and Hiro will align.

Thanks — we’ll act on the questionnaire and mark items we can answer directly vs items requiring security evidence. 

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Program Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
